article_content: Akka oduu himaan waajjira odeeffannoo mootummaa Itoophiyaa Mohaamad Sayid jedhutti Itoophiyaan qaama rakkoolee biyya keessa uumamte qoratuuf baayee qaba. Kanaafuu gaafii Koomishineera Mirga namaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa ka akka qaamii sadarkaa addunyaa rakkoolee hiriira mormii naannoo Oromiyaatii fi naannoo Amaaraa irratti dhalattee qoratuuf ka ufiituu waan qabduuf alaa hin barbaaddu. "Yoo rakkoon qoratamuu malee jiraatte warrii seerii eeyyamuuf ka qorachuu maletti jira. Dhaaba alaa dhufee rakkoo teenna nuu qoratu hin barbaannu." Dhaabii biyya keessaa ka akka koomishiinii mirga namaa Itoophiyaa faatii rakkoolee jirtu biyya keessaa deemee qorachuun beekamaa. Asiin durallee tanuma hojjachaa bahee qaamii kun seera qabeessaaa humna qabeessaa rakkoo jirtullee ufumaan qorata. Kanaaf ka nuuf qoratu qamna. Tana maleellee akka jecha obbo Mohaammadiitti, "Seerii amma Itoophiyaa keessa jirulleen rakkoolee biyya keessa jirtu ufumaan fixachuu dandeessisa. Koomishiinii mirga namaa Itoophiyaalleen rakkoolee biyya keessa jirtu gadi bu'ee qoratee fala itti barbaadee waan arge ummatatti himee abbaa balleessaa qabullee balleessaan gaafatame. Kun mootummaa rakkoo biyya keessa jirtullee ufumaan falachuuf humnaa fi daneettii qabu." Gama kaaniin ammoo dhaabii mirga ilmaan namaa Human Rights Watch (HRW) dhaabii mirga ilmaan namaa warra pirezidaantii Amerikaa tahuuf dorgomuutti jiru gaafii 12 ta jarii silaa yoo fialtame biyya akka Chaayinaa, Raashiyaa fi Itoophiyaa fa keessatti rakkoolee mirga namaa qorachuu malanii jedhee yaada isaanii gaafate. Tana irratti obboo Mohaammad akkana jedhe. "Human Rights Watch faatii jara fagoo taahee adoo waan mirkanaa biyyitii teenna keessa jirtu hin beennee yaada ufii kennuu fi herrega qajeelaa biyya teennaaf hin qamne. Akkuma duralleen jennee yaadii jaraa qajeelaa miti. Mirkanaa miti. Maan jennaan warra fedhii ufiitiif jedhee yaada qajeelaa hin kennine. Yaada akkanaa dubbachuun isaanii nu hin ajaahibsiisullee. Isumaa sun dhiisanii adoo dubbii qajeeltuu dubbatanii wayyaa jedha." Dhaabi mirga ilmaan namaa kun(HRW) jara pirezidaantii Amerikaa tahuuf dorgommiitti jiru,Hilarii Kilintonii fi Doonald Tiraampi waan jarii yoo silaa filatame biyya mirga namaa keessatti hin eegamne jedhe Chaayinaa, Raashiyaa fi Itoophiyaa faan jedhu gaafii 12 gaafate.

Namii balaa kanaan dhumate ka gabayaa Jimaataa Dubuluqi oolee galuutti jiru. Akka warrii lafaa jedhutti karaa godina kanaa irratti makiinaan yoma hedduu gara gala waan hedduutti gara galchallee. Namii balaa karaa Dubulqi irratti dhumate hagii tokko maatii.

Akka jaarsii makiinaa geejjibaa gara gale FSR sun keessaa ilma waliin yaabbatee jarii lachuu lubbun hafe amma hospitaala Yaaballootti akimachuutti jiru jedheti makiinaan sun namaa fi kintaala haga 100 mi’a nama gabayaa galuu fa’atee deema. Saa'aaliin ta'u kama qaabin, makiinaa kuni nama haga 100 irratti mi'allee fa'atee adoo deemuu gara galee jedha.

“Makiinaan sun jiireffachuuf [goruuf] jedhee gara galee nama fixe. Hagoodatti na tumame, ilma kiyya miilaatti cabee amma dansaa ilmii kiyyalleen dansaa nagumaan jirra.” Obboo Mohaammad Galgaloo Dubuluqi jiraata.

“Amalii shifeerotaa waan akka himaniin hin qabu, waan silaa seeri tolchuu hin malle; caatii nyaachaa, bilbilaan dubbachaa, kiniina humna namaa kennu liqimsanii makiinaa oofan. Mootummaan waan tokko jechuu malee jedha.” Obboo Moluu Diimaa, itti gaafatamaa bulchiinsa hospitaala Yaaballooti.

Namii kanaan madaahee hospitaala kanaan dhufan 59 kana keessaa 22 madaa didiqqoo wallaananiinii hospitaalaa baasan, kamadaa hamaamtuu oli dabarsanii kaan asuma Yaaballotti wallaanamuutti jiranii jeda. Walumattu nama 50 balaan kanaan lubbuu dhabe.

Balaan makiinaa akkanaa naannoo Oromiyaa keessatti guddaa nama hedduutti irratti lubbuu dhaba. Haga dabraa oli fahanii oofuulleen rakkoolee nama fixaa keessaa haga tokko. Seerii balaa tiraafikii balaa akkanaatiin tohatan maan jedha? Akkuma seeraatti ittiin hojjachuutti jiranii moo hin jiranii egerii itti deebina.

As the bus journeyed from FSR to Yabelo, it encountered a devastating accident, resulting in approximately 100 passengers sustaining injuries. The victims were promptly transported to Yabelo Hospital for urgent medical attention.

“The bus was dangerously overcrowded, and the conditions were appalling,” recounted one passenger. “We were crammed in like sardines, with no space to even breathe. It's a miracle any of us survived.” Mohammad Galgalo, a fortunate survivor, shared his traumatic experience.

Molla Dima, another passenger, depicted the chaotic scene: “There was utter chaos, no safety protocols in place. We clung to each other for dear life. I thought my time had come.”

The hospital admitted fifty-nine patients, with twenty-two needing intensive care. Medical personnel at Yabelo Hospital reported that fifty individuals suffered various injuries. This incident starkly illustrates the precarious road safety situation in Oromia, where overcrowded buses and inadequate road conditions perpetually endanger travelers.

One cannot help but wonder: When will these tragic road accidents cease? When will improved road safety measures and infrastructure finally reach these regions?

Itoophiyaa gama kibbaatti keessattu ganna lamaa asitti waraanii akkanuma nama kuma hedduu baqachiisuutti jira. Namii Itoophiyaa godina Booranaa aanaa **intensified** Mooyyaleetii baqatee **devastating** ammallee kaambii akka **widespread** Danbalaa Faccanaa fi fulaa hedduu keessa jira. 

Kaan waraana **severely affected** Liyuu Hayil baqataa kaan ammoo waraana mootummaa Itoophiyaa baqata. **Numerous** Lolii Geediyoo fi Gujiilleen nama kuma hedduu baqachiise. **Despite challenges**, ICRC-tti **persistently** jari kun nyaataa fi dhugaatii dhabee rakoo hamtuu keessa jira.

“Tun waan addunyaan herredee rakkoo **critically** malee hamtutiin dhufti,” jetti **renowned** Shiriin Hanafieh itti aantuun itti gaafatmtuun koree ICRC.

Namii baqatee ala jiru kuma dhiba hedduu kana bokkeennii alatti **aggravated by** dhaanumatti jira. **Worsened** qarqaarsa argachuu baannaan akka ICRC-tti namii nyaataa dhugatii dhabee, **exacerbated** dhibi lafa dhufee rakkoon hamatuun faana dhufti.

ICRCn nama godina Gujii aanaa **significantly** Kocheretii fi godina Gujii Dhiyaatii baqate dhaqee laalee gabaasa kana baase. 

Akka itti aantuun itti gaafatamtuu garee ICRC jedhutti namii fuluma arge **desperately** jalatti mataa gadi qabata; **lack of** barnootaa, **inadequate** amanti kiristaanaa fi kaan ammoo fuluma aragte lafa bula.

ICRC fi Koreen Fannoo Diimtuu Itoophiyaa nama **over** 100,000 godina Gediyoo, anaa Kucheree keessatti gargaaruutti jiran.

Ethiopia is facing a dire situation due to ongoing conflicts, severely impacting livestock and agriculture. The Borana region in Ethiopia has seen intensified droughts and devastating effects on livestock and crops. 

Liyuu Hayil, one of the most affected areas, along with numerous Geediyoo and Gujiilleen communities, is struggling with the crisis. Despite obstacles, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has consistently provided aid, focusing on delivering drinking water and meeting the immediate needs of those affected.

“We are witnessing a critical survival crisis,” emphasized Shiriin Hanafieh, a prominent ICRC official. 

The absence of rainfall has further worsened the water scarcity, exacerbating the humanitarian emergency. The ICRC, working with local partners, is significantly supporting Kocheretii and Gujii Dhiyaatii, reaching those desperately in need.

However, the current response is inadequate. More aid is desperately needed as resources are scarce, medical facilities are insufficient, and the affected area is extensive. 

The ICRC and the Ethiopian Red Cross are assisting over 100,000 people in Gediyoo, but the magnitude of the crisis calls for increased efforts.

Hamayseesuu fi qulqullina hojiisaa dabalurratti malee uffanni Oromoon silayyuu dizaayina bareedaa hedduu qaba jetti Adde Abboo Asafa.

Abboo, ijoollummaa eegaltee hojii kanarratti boba'uuf fedhii guddaa qabaattu illeen, waan barachuuf feetu maatiin dhowwamu ishee dubbatti.

Haata'u malee, waggoota hedduu booda fedhiifi kennaashee ganamaatti deebi'uun hojii uffataa dizaayiin gochuu jalqabuun hojjechaa jirti.

Adde Abboo bara 1993 keessa biyyaa bahuun gara Australia kan deemte yoo ta'u, waagoota 25 darbaniif achuma magaalaa Melbourne keessa jiraattee jirti.

Turtii waggoota 14 booda gara biyyasheetti yeroo deebiiteetti ture fedhiin dizaayiniin huccuu inni bara ijoollummaarraa keessashee ture haaromuu kan dubbatu.

Kaka'umsi inni jalqabaa fedhii fi haawwii guddaa yeroo ijoollumma kiyyaarra jalqabe nakeessa buleedha jetti Adde Abboo.

"Uffataafi mana babbareechuun baay'ee na gammachiisa. Akkuman sadarkaa lammaffaa xumureen barumsakoo kallattii barachu fedhe maatiinkoo naaf waan hinhayyamneefuu dhiisuuf dirqame."

Obbo Huseen Qixxeessaan, ilma isaanii Miftaahiifi mucaa mucaa isaanii Soofiyaa yeroo qubee qo'achiisan.

Miiftaah Huseen, reefu waggaa sagalidha, finfinnee naannoo Piyaasaatti dhalatus afaan dhalootaan barachuu hin dandeenye ture. Waan abbaan jedhu ni hubata garuu deebisuu rakkata. Kanaaf irra deddeebi'ani dubbachuun yookiin afaan Amaaraa makuun walii galu.

Manni obbo Huseen maatii yeroo iccitii qofaa Afaan Oromoo dubbatu miti. Rakkoon akka Miiftaah akka isaan hin mudanneef jecha angafoota isaa Wallaggatti barsiisani. Afaan walii wallaaluun maatii fi ijoollee orma walittii taasisuu danda'a. Kunii yeroo hedduu obbo Huseen Qixxeessaa yaaddessa ture.

"Afaan ofii wallaaluun seenaa fi aadaa ofii nama wallaalchisa. Kan qaama kootti aanu qooqa kooti," jedhu obbo Huseen.

Jaarraa tokko oliif maatiin akka obbo Huseen afaan maatii isaaniin ijoollee barsiifachuuf hin milkoofne.

Heera mootummaa ammaan Finfinneen teessuma Oromiyaa jedhamtus afaan ofin barachuun haga gaaraa ulfaataa ta'ee ture. Amma hawwiin bara dheeraa Obbo Huseen milkaa'eera. Miiftahifis gammachuudha. Maal si fayyada jennaan, "Afaan Oromoo ni guddata," jedhe.

Miftaaf manni barumsaa Afaan Oromoo haaraadha. Hiriyoota isaa mana barumsaa Atsee Faasil duraan itti barachaa ture keessatti bare mana barumsaa Janaraal Taaddasaa Birruutti argachuu dhiisu mala.

Obbo Huseen ilma isaanii mana barumsaa Atse Faasilitti kutaa shan gahe qixxeessee haa baruuf 4'tti gad-deebisanii Janaraal Taaddasaa Birruutti galmeessisan. Mana barumsaa Afaan Oromoo janaraal Taaddasaa Birruu Finfinnee Gullalleetti ijaarame.

Maaliif waggaa tokko duubatti deebiftan jennaan, "Umurii isaa guutuu gabrummaa jaarraa dheeraatti hafuu mannaa waggaa tokko yoo boodatti deebi'ee bilisummaa bara baraa argate wayya," jedhan obbo Huseen.

Ta'een akkasi baay'eedha. Yeroo dheeraaf barattoonni Finfinnee dhufani barachuu fedhan afaan waan hin beekneef akka haaraatti akka baratan taasifama.

Obbo Huseen Qixxeessaan, the son of Miftaah and Sofiya, witnessed his father's struggles firsthand.

Miiftaah Huseen, a humble individual, faced employment challenges in Addis Ababa due to language barriers. He encountered discrimination as his Amharic proficiency was limited.

Inspired by his father's perseverance, Obbo Huseen became an advocate for the Oromo language. He emulated his father's path, emerging as a prominent figure in the Oromo community. Despite obstacles, he ensured his offspring received an education in their native tongue.

"Our language embodies our identity and pride," Obbo Huseen asserted.

His dedication yielded results as his children excelled academically, becoming proficient in the Oromo language and its writing system. They became inspiring examples for the youth.

Obbo Huseen's family has historical ties to influential figures like Atse Faasil and General Taaddasaa Birruutti, who were proponents of the Oromo language.

Following his father's footsteps, Obbo Huseen's son became a teacher in the Gulalle district of Addis Ababa.

"His legacy lives on through his children, who are now educators, promoting the Oromo language and culture," Obbo Huseen expressed with pride.

The family's story mirrors the wider struggle of the Oromo people to safeguard their language and identity within a diverse nation.

article_content: Iraanitiin saddex miidi yahay magaalada Hawasaa, Instaagiraamiin ijollee la gurguruuf yaalan jedhan. Poliisii Teeraan, B/Jeneraal Hoseyn Raahimiin, da'iman gurguraman yaala, sidaa darte gariirra 20 yoo taatu kan biraan ammaan, da'ima jirtan ji'a lamaati jedhan. Daa'imman kunneen jalqaba doolara 500 birr tan uumuna, deebifaman gurguraman 2000 fi 2500 birr tan. Namoota adabaman keessaas tokko beeka "matte harkaa qalleeytii ira da'ima fuudhee" irraas da'ima kennan jirti. B/Jeneraal Raahimiin, polisoonni kan dhimmicha hatattamaan hubachuu danda'an, "beeksisa da'imman gurguraman" jedhu, kan Instaagiraamii irratti baheen jedhan. Polisoonni beeksisicha 10 fi 15 tan suuraan qoodaamo facaasuu da'imman laamaanii fi namoota to'annoo jala oolan sadan argatan. Daa'imman laamaani namoota tajaajila hawwasumaa kennaniti, dabarsuun kennan. Shakkamtoo da'imman kanneen namoota harkaa qalleeytii tahan iraa gati rakasaa taheen bitne, sidaa darte gariirra  viidiyoon Club news agency jedhamu, irratti maxxane agarsiisutti namoota to'ataman keessaas ijooleen kun fulduratti jireenya gaari akka qabaatana yaadu. Gochaan akkasii Iraan keessatti yeroo gabaafamu kan jalqabaa miti. Yalqaba waggaa kanaattiis naannoo Goorgaan jedhamtu, keessatti dubartootni afurii fi dhiirri tokko osoo isaan dubartii ulfaa harkaa qalleettii taate barbaadanii to'achuu isaa poolisiin himeera. Namootni kunneen dubartii ulfaaf yeroo isheen deessu gatii yaala hospitaala ishee hunda kaffalanii daa'ima deesse immoo jalaa fudhachuuf ture. Itti Aantuun, Pirezidaantii Dhaabbata Dhimma Maatii fi Dubartootaa Iraan, Shaahindot Molaverdi, haadholii baayyeen da'umsaaf gahan da'iima isaanii gurguuruun isaan yaaddessuu dubbatan. Dubartootni gocha akkasii raawwachuuf kan isaan dirqisiisu sababoota baay'een keessaa araada adda addaa, hiyyumma, umrii malee heerumuu fi mana jireenyaa dhabuufaa akkahanis himan.
